answers.rationale: This requirement pertains to software or display functionality, which is not directly related to any product in the catalog. The bid manager should address this.
The requirement specifies PCB manufacturing and population with SMDs, compliant with IPC Class II. EMS-PCBA covers advanced PCBA and microelectronics assembly, which aligns with this requirement.
The quantity of 10 PCBs per design is a manufacturing detail. EMS-PCBA includes capabilities for custom PCB assembly, making it suitable for this requirement.
